findings.reason: the reader needs a named owner and a source for the turn count, or it will hard-code a second copy of the B_phi relation that the converter already owns.
findings.text: §6 has read_signal_map_observation "derive the toroidal field from the TF map's coil current through the tf description's field per ampere", but that value has no owner in the store the plan names: the converted tf description deliberately leaves `tf/coil[:]/turns` and `tf/coils_n` unset (recorded validation gaps in `/work/projects/imas_gpu/jt60sa/machine_description/OP1/receipt.json`), the receipt carries no `tf_b_field_phi_vacuum_r` (selene_deck.write_phase_description only computes it when both tf_current and tf_turns are supplied, selene_deck.py:1298), and the relation B_phi(R0)=mu0*turns*current/(2*pi*R0) has its sole implementation in derive_b_field_phi_vacuum_r (imas_ambix/data/selene_deck.py:765), which the plan does not cite; the same relation is also bound nowhere in imas_ambix/data/maps/jt-60sa/tf.json, whose only rule targets `tf/coil/current/data`.

findings.reason: the section must name the raw read path (the map's source_group/source_array read directly, bypassing apply) or admit it reads the applied transform, since the two give different signs precisely where the adjudication is decided.
findings.text: §6's read_signal_map_observation "reads every value raw with no sign or unit factor applied" while reading through "load_packaged_signal_map and VirtualZarrView over the EDDB cache", but VirtualArray.__getitem__ returns `self.signal.apply(self._source[selection])` (imas_ambix/data/virtual_zarr.py:75-76), i.e. the compiled affine transform (unit x sign x COCOS) is applied on every read and the view exposes no raw accessor, so the named machinery cannot produce the raw series the section requires — and because the §5 rules are source-only with an assumed channel_factor +1, reading through the transform silently applies a sign §6 has not yet measured, defeating the sign report it feeds.

rubric_items.deep_module: pass — substantial behaviour stays behind existing deep interfaces: the canonical EfitLabels record is the one equilibrium shape, StoreEngine is the store seam, and the sign logic hides behind the private _observation_from_series kernel, so the readers are shallow by design over a deep core rather than a spread of shallow wrappers.
rubric_items.duplicate_owner: a finding — read_signal_map_observation depends on a TF field-per-ampere the description store does not carry and whose only owner (selene_deck.derive_b_field_phi_vacuum_r) the plan never cites, and it claims raw reads through a transform-applying view that applies the very sign §6 exists to measure.
rubric_items.interface_budget: pass — public_definitions 0, cli_options 0, mcp_views 0, refusal_families 0; every section that adds surface (the tokamap exporter, the eddb_remote/eddb modules and their two refusal families, read_signal_map_observation replacing read_catalogue_observation, measure_convention, the EQDB request/record types, the machine-keyed pin table and its re-export) names in its own text what it retires or merges, or states why nothing can be.
rubric_items.reuse_search: pass — the design names and extends existing machinery at every proposable point (cocos_convention.score_convention/score_conventions/surviving_conventions, gs/operator.build_operator and cocos.project_poloidal_field, gs/artifact_resolution.resolve_machine_description, gs/machine_identity.default_registry, challenges/convention.py._integrated_current, eval/efit_referee.judge_geometry, spine_bench/shots.py, description_reader._supply_emitted_probe_angles), and each named mechanism was confirmed present and reachable in the tree.
rubric_items.thin_wrapper: pass — the plan does not layer readers on readers: challenge/convention.measure_convention is a genuine generalisation (measure_diiid_convention becomes a call to it, verified at challenge/convention.py:341), the EQDB request/record types extend the existing eddb_remote extractor and the grid writer shares write_channel's extracted invariants, and read_signal_map_observation retires read_catalogue_observation rather than sitting beside it.
